description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Marwyn.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Marwyn.
Repeat.

uses.name: Marwyn, the Nurturer
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater
